```{r}
#combine covariate, treatment, and response data 

# TREATMENT - pesticide - PUBMEC_L -> PUB100
# COVARIATES - ..., alcohol use (ALQ_L), demographics (DEMO_L), diabetes (DIQ_L), 
# income (INQ_L), physical activity (PAQY_L, PAQ_L), sleep (SLQ), smoking (SMQ),
# weight (WHQ_L) 
# RESPONSE - blood pressure - (BPXO_L) or high blood pressure (BPQ_L) 
```



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

insecticide <- read_xpt("Data/PUQMEC_L.xpt")
high_blood_pressure <- read_xpt("Data/BPQ_L.xpt")
blood_pressure <- read_xpt("Data/BPXO_L.xpt")
```

## first identify helpful treatment / response variables 

```{r}
data <- high_blood_pressure %>%
  full_join(blood_pressure, by = "SEQN") %>%
  right_join(insecticide, by = "SEQN") 


```

```{r}
#rename 
data_clean <- data %>%
  rename(
    # ID
    respondent_id = SEQN,
    
    # Blood pressure measurement setup
    bp_arm = BPAOARM,
    bp_cuff_size = BPAOCSZ,
    
    # Systolic readings
    systolic_1 = BPXOSY1,
    systolic_2 = BPXOSY2,
    systolic_3 = BPXOSY3,
    
    # Diastolic readings
    diastolic_1 = BPXODI1,
    diastolic_2 = BPXODI2,
    diastolic_3 = BPXODI3,
    
    # Pulse readings
    pulse_1 = BPXOPLS1,
    pulse_2 = BPXOPLS2,
    pulse_3 = BPXOPLS3,
    
    # Blood pressure questionnaire
    told_high_bp = BPQ020,
    high_bp_multiple_times = BPQ030,
    bp_medication = BPQ150,
    
    # Cholesterol
    told_high_cholesterol = BPQ080,
    cholesterol_medication = BPQ101D,
    
    # Environmental exposure
    insecticide_home_use = PUQ100,
    weed_killer_use = PUQ110
  )
```

```{r}
table(data_clean$insecticide_home_use, useNA = "always")
#table(data_clean$weed_killer_use, useNA = "always") #much less

```

```{r}
potential_responses <- c("systolic_1", "systolic_2", "systolic_3", "diastolic_1",
                        "diastolic_2", "diastolic_3", "told_high_bp", 
                        "high_bp_multiple_times")

#graph 

#table(data_clean$systolic_1, useNA = "always")
#table(data_clean$told_high_bp, useNA = "always")
table(data_clean$high_bp_multiple_times, useNA = "always")
```


```{r}
missing_counts <- data_clean %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(potential_responses), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "missing_count")

# Plot
ggplot(missing_counts, aes(x = variable, y = missing_count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Missing Values by Variable",
    x = "Variable",
    y = "Count of Missing Values"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```




```{r}
#count of treatment and control using non-missing told_high_bp vs diastolic_1

data_high_bp <- data_clean %>%
  drop_na(told_high_bp)
  


table(data_high_bp$insecticide_home_use, useNA = "always")

```

```{r}
#count of treatment and control using non-missing told_high_bp vs diastolic_1

data_high_bp <- data_clean %>%
  drop_na(systolic_1)
  


table(data_high_bp$insecticide_home_use, useNA = "always")

```


```{r}
#leaning towards:
#treatment: insecticide_home_use
#response: told_high_bp
#approx 1:12 trt:control ratio 
```

## construct final dataset:

```{r}
DEMO_L <- read_xpt("Data/DEMO_L.xpt")
ALQ_L <- read_xpt("Data/ALQ_L.xpt")
DIQ_L <- read_xpt("Data/DIQ_L.xpt")
INQ_L <- read_xpt("Data/INQ_L.xpt")
PAQ_L <- read_xpt("Data/PAQ_L.xpt")
PAQY_L <- read_xpt("Data/PAQY_L.xpt")
SLQ_L <- read_xpt("Data/SLQ_L.xpt")
SMQ_L <- read_xpt("Data/SMQ_L.xpt")
WHQ_L <- read_xpt("Data/WHQ_L.xpt")
```

```{r}
final_df <- insecticide %>%
  inner_join(high_blood_pressure, by = "SEQN")  %>%
  select(SEQN, PUQ100, BPQ020, BPQ080) %>% #told high bp, use insecticides, cholesterol  
  drop_na(PUQ100, BPQ020)  %>% #drop rows where the treatment, response is NA
  rename(
    # ID, treatment, control, cholesterol 
    respondent_id = SEQN,
    told_high_bp = BPQ020,
    told_high_cholesterol = BPQ080,
    insecticide_home_use = PUQ100
  )
```

```{r}
final_df <- final_df %>%
  
  #join other covariates 
  left_join(DEMO_L, by = "respondent_id") %>% #demographics
  left_join(ALQ_L, by = "respondent_id") %>% #alcohol
  left_join(DIQ_L, by = "respondent_id") %>% #diabetes
  left_join(INQ_L, by = "respondent_id") %>% #income
  left_join(PAQY_L, by = "respondent_id") %>% #physical activity
  left_join(PAQ_L, by = "respondent_id") %>% #physical activity 
  left_join(SLQ_L, by = "respondent_id") %>% #sleep disorders 
  left_join(SMQ_L, by = "respondent_id") %>% #smoking
  left_join(WHQ_L, by = "respondent_id") %>% #weight
  
  rename(
    # ---------------- DEMO ----------------
    survey_cycle = SDDSRVYR,
    interview_exam_status = RIDSTATR,
    gender = RIAGENDR,
    age_years = RIDAGEYR,
    age_months_screening = RIDAGEMN,
    race_ethnicity = RIDRETH1,
    race_ethnicity_detailed = RIDRETH3,
    exam_period_6mo = RIDEXMON,
    age_months_exam = RIDEXAGM,
    active_duty_military = DMQMILIZ,
    country_of_birth = DMDBORN4,
    years_in_us = DMDYRUSR,
    education_level = DMDEDUC2,
    marital_status = DMDMARTZ,
    pregnancy_status = RIDEXPRG,
    household_size = DMDHHSIZ,
    hh_reference_gender = DMDHRGND,
    hh_reference_age = DMDHRAGZ,
    hh_reference_education = DMDHREDZ,
    hh_reference_marital_status = DMDHRMAZ,
    hh_spouse_education = DMDHSEDZ,
    interview_weight_2yr = WTINT2YR,
    exam_weight_2yr = WTMEC2YR,
    pseudo_stratum = SDMVSTRA,
    pseudo_psu = SDMVPSU,
    income_poverty_ratio = INDFMPIR,
    
    # ---------------- ALQ (Alcohol) ----------------
    ever_alcohol = ALQ111,
    alcohol_freq_12mo = ALQ121,
    alcohol_avg_drinks_per_day = ALQ130,
    binge_days_12mo = ALQ142,
    binge_2hr_episodes_12mo = ALQ270,
    heavy_drinking_days_12mo = ALQ280,
    ever_daily_binge = ALQ151,
    binge_days_past_month = ALQ170,
    
    # ---------------- DIQ (Diabetes) ----------------
    diabetes_diagnosed = DIQ010,
    age_diabetes_diagnosis = DID040,
    prediabetes = DIQ160,
    glucose_test_3yr = DIQ180,
    insulin_now = DIQ050,
    insulin_duration = DID060,
    insulin_duration_unit = DIQ060U,
    diabetes_pills = DIQ070,
    
    # ---------------- INQ (Income) ----------------
    monthly_poverty_index = INDFMMPI,
    monthly_poverty_category = INDFMMPC,
    savings_over_20k = INQ300,
    total_family_savings = IND310,
    
    # ---------------- PAQ (Physical Activity) ----------------
    mod_activity_freq = PAD790Q,
    mod_activity_unit = PAD790U,
    mod_activity_minutes = PAD800,
    vig_activity_freq = PAD810Q,
    vig_activity_unit = PAD810U,
    vig_activity_minutes = PAD820,
    sedentary_minutes = PAD680,
    
    # ---------------- PAQY (Youth Activity) ----------------
    active_days_60min = PAQ706,
    screen_time_hours = PAQ711,
    
    # ---------------- SLQ (Sleep) ----------------
    sleep_time_weekday = SLQ300,
    wake_time_weekday = SLQ310,
    sleep_hours_weekday = SLD012,
    sleep_time_weekend = SLQ320,
    wake_time_weekend = SLQ330,
    sleep_hours_weekend = SLD013,
    
    # ---------------- SMQ (Smoking) ----------------
    smoked_100_cigs = SMQ020,
    current_smoker = SMQ040,
    smoking_days_30d = SMD641,
    cigarettes_per_day = SMD650,
    menthol_cigarette = SMD100MN,
    lifetime_cigarettes = SMQ621,
    age_first_cigarette = SMD630,
    smoking_questionnaire_mode = SMAQUEX2,
    
    # ---------------- WHQ (Weight/Height) ----------------
    height_inches = WHD010,
    weight_pounds = WHD020,
    weight_1yr_ago = WHD050,
    tried_lose_weight = WHQ070
  ) %>%

  #select relevant variables 
  select(respondent_id, told_high_bp, insecticide_home_use, told_high_cholesterol 
         ) #%>%


  #recode relevant variables
    





```
